# keep the legacy mirrors table of the question and only put /v2 in front of the project: the endpoint path replaces /v2,
# so containerd asks Harbor for /v2/kubernetes-cache/kube-proxy/... as Harbor wants it
sudo sed -i "s#harbor.bench77342162.test:8083/kubernetes-cache'#harbor.bench77342162.test:8083/v2/kubernetes-cache'#" /run/bench77342162/config.toml
grep -n 'kubernetes-cache' /run/bench77342162/config.toml
sudo /var/lib/bench77342162/bin/containerdctl restart

# the usual hosts.toml with only Harbor's address: containerd asks /v2/kube-proxy/... without the project, Harbor answers 400
sudo python3 - <<'PY'
import re
path = "/run/bench77342162/config.toml"
text = open(path).read()
text = re.sub(r"\n# the mirror of the question.*\Z", "\n", text, flags=re.S)
out, section = [], ""
for line in text.splitlines(True):
    m = re.match(r"^\s*\[+\s*([^\]]+?)\s*\]+\s*$", line)
    if m:
        section = m.group(1).strip("'\"")
    if section.endswith(".registry") and "cri" in section and re.match(r"^\s*config_path\s*=", line):
        line = re.sub(r"=.*", "= '/etc/containerd/certs.d'", line) + "\n"
    out.append(line)
open(path, "w").writelines(out)
PY
